```{=html}
<p>I contribute to research software that makes computational methods accessible in everyday research practice.</p>
<h2>ASReview LAB</h2>
<h3>Active learning for systematic reviews</h3>
<p>ASReview LAB helps researchers screen large collections of titles and abstracts. It learns from screening decisions to prioritize records for further review.</p>
<p>My contributions include developing interfaces in React and REST APIs connecting the interface to Python servers, contributing to the first stable release, writing documentation, and improving usability through user feedback. I continued as a volunteer maintainer after my research-engineer appointment at Utrecht University.</p>
<div class="actions"><a href="https://github.com/asreview/asreview" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View project ↗</a><a class="github-button" href="https://github.com/asreview/asreview" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Star ASReview on GitHub" data-size="large" data-show-count="true">Star</a></div>
<h2>ASReview-wordcloud</h2>
<h3>Exploring the text in review datasets</h3>
<p>ASReview-wordcloud creates word-cloud visualizations from systematic review datasets, offering a quick impression of their textual content.</p>
<p>My work included processing dataset metadata in Python and developing visualizations of titles and abstracts.</p>
<div class="actions"><a href="https://github.com/asreview/asreview-wordcloud" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View project ↗</a><a class="github-button" href="https://github.com/asreview/asreview-wordcloud" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Star ASReview-wordcloud on GitHub" data-size="large" data-show-count="true">Star</a></div>
```
